title: RGI 7.0 glacier intersects
description:
One row per intersect: a line that divides two adjacent glaciers, with the IDs of both glaciers, in one GeoParquet file. The web map archive holds the lines from z10.

This is an unofficial mirror, not endorsed by the RGI Consortium. The authoritative source is [RGI 7.0 at NSIDC](https://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0770/versions/7). Citation and credit belong to the RGI Consortium:

> RGI 7.0 Consortium. (2023). *Randolph Glacier Inventory: A dataset of global glacier outlines* (Version 7.0) [Data set]. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/F6JMOVY5NAVZ
sci:citation: RGI 7.0 Consortium. (2023). Randolph Glacier Inventory: A dataset of global glacier outlines (Version 7.0) [Data set]. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/F6JMOVY5NAVZ

table:columns.name: rgi_id
table:columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a single intersect line by the RGI

table:columns.name: rgi_g_id_1
table:columns.description: Glacier ID of one side of the intersect (arbitrary)

table:columns.name: rgi_g_id_2
table:columns.description: Glacier ID of the other side of the intersect (arbitrary)

table:columns.name: length_m
table:columns.description: Length of the intersect in meters

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), the GeoParquet covering column. Readers use it to skip row groups in a spatial filter.

style-intersects.title: Intersects
style-intersects.description: Intersects (black): the divides between adjacent glaciers, from z10, over the glacier outlines (pale blue).

style-full-map.title: Glaciers with names
style-full-map.description: Glacier outlines (blue) and centerlines (red), with glacier names and the boundaries and names of the glacier regions. Larger glaciers are named at lower zooms.
